FILE

Subsequent to the assassination of Mr. CHENG
HAI DAO (程海), Clerk and Acting Chief of the
Chinese Staff of the Political Section of the French
Police, which took place on the morning of October 18,
one CHIEN ZUNG LOONG (錢成龍), accompanied by a
plain-clothes member of the Japanese Military Police
called at French Police Headquarters at 9 p.m. the
same day and offered assistance in effecting the
arrest of persons alleged to be connected with the
murder. CHIEN was a former detective sub-inspector
of the French Police dismissed for being involved in
an opium smuggling case, and is at present a section
chief of the "Special Service Corps of the Chung Kuo
Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National Salvation Army,"
a pro-WANG CHING WEI organization with headquarters at
76 Jessfield Road.

Acting on this information, the French Police
carried out raids between 3 a.m. and 6.30 a.m. October
19 and 5 p.m. the same day at various places in the
French Concession with the result that altogether
sixteen suspects were taken into custody. Details
relating to the number of persons arrested and the
places raided are as follows :

Address | No. of arrests
---|---
(1) Room 503 Dah Woo Hotel (大滬飯店), 341 Avenue Edward VII. | One named WONG TSENG MING (王振民), age 32, a native of Shanghai.

归档

继法租界巡捕房政治部华籍职员兼代理主管程海刀（CHENG HAI DAO，程海）于10月18日上午遇刺后，一名叫钱成龍（CHIEN ZUNG LOONG）的人，随同一名便衣日本宪兵，于当晚9时前往法租界巡捕房总部，表示愿协助逮捕据称与谋杀案有关的人员。钱成龍曾是法租界巡捕房的侦探副督察，因卷入鸦片走私案被革职，目前担任“中国国民党反共救国军特别服务队”（汪精卫派系组织，总部设在极司菲尔路76号）的科长。

根据这一情报，法租界巡捕房于10月19日凌晨3时至6时30分以及当日下午5时，在法租界多处地点进行突击搜查，结果共拘留了十六名嫌疑人。关于被捕人数及搜查地点的详情如下：

地址 | 逮捕人数
---|---
(1) 爱多亚路341号大沪饭店503室。 | 一名，王振民（WONG TSENG MING），32岁，上海籍。

Twelve persons including one LU FAH LIANG (呂相良) who were arrested during the course of a search by the French Police at Leung Kiang No. 2 Lodging House, 317 Avenue Edward VII on October 18, were released the following day. They were found to be members of the "China Peace National Salvation Alliance Army", which is under organization by the WANG CHING WEI clique, and are not connected with the murder case.

SHANGHAI TIMES, OCT 19 1939
25932
Chinese Head Of French
Police Political Branch
Assassinated In Morning
Shot In Head And Back By Gunmen Whilst Riding
In Private Ricsha; Predecessor Was Also
Shot In Similar Manner On May 6
ASSASSINS MAKE GOOD THEIR ESCAPE
ALONG EMPTY STREET; COOLIE HIT
Mr. Zeng Hai-do, 38-year-old Acting Chief Chinese
Inspector of the Political Department of the French Municipal
Police, was brutally assassinated in the Concession yesterday
morning. Mr. Zeng was shot and fatally wounded in the head
and back whilst riding in a ricsha on his way to office at 7.45
a.m. He was just nearing Rue Amiral Bayle, along Rue Conty,
when he was shot by four gunmen.
Mr. Zeng had taken over the duties of the late Mr. Tsao
Ping-sung, former Chinese head of the Political Department
of the French Police, who was also assassinated by unidentified
gangsters in his Concession residence on Route Herves des
Sieyes on the morning of May 6.
The latest victim of assassins'
bullets had just left his home at
Lane 685, House 40, Rue Conty
and was riding in a ricsha when in
front of a Chinese factory at 309
Rue Centy, he was suddenly ap-
proached by two men who called
him by name. On hearing Mr.
Zeng called by name, the ricsha
puller slowed-down, but before he
or the victim could ascertain what
was happening, two other men ap-
proached from behind with drawn
pistols and fired four shots at Mr.
Zeng.
One bullet lodged itself in Mr.
Zeng's head, another found its
mark in his left shoulder, while
the third penetrated his back. The
fourth bullet inflicted a flesh
wound in the neck of the victim's
ricsha puller.
Gunmen Escape
With the road almost deserted in
the early hour of the morning and
there being no police officers in the
vicinity, the assassins scattered and
made good their escape. Police
were immediately called and an
ambulance sent to the scene of the
shooting. The victim was already
dead upon arrival of the ambul-
ance and instead of being rushed
to hospital, he was taken to his
home.
Apart from the ricsha puller,
who was frightened out of his
wits, no other eye-witnesses to the
shooting could be found yesterday.
The puller could supply very little
information regarding the assassins.
He saw them, but could hardly de-
scribe them.
Long Service
Mr. Zeng had been in the service
of the French Municipal Police for
the past 12 years. Prior to his ap-
pointment as Acting Chief Chinese
Inspector to the Political Depart-
ment in succession of Mr. Tsao, he
was the chief translator in the same
department.
The deceased was 38 at the time
of his death. He was a native of
Hweichow, in Anhwei province. His
untimely death was deeply regret-
ted yesterday by his superiors and
fellow workers. Mr. Zeng leaves
behind his wife and three sons,
aged 12, 15 and 18, a younger
brother and a sister, as well as his
64-year-old father, all of whom
were living with him at the time
of his death.
With all the assassins having made
good their escape prior to the ar-
rival of the police, detectives were
pushing extensive inquiries all day
yesterday with a view to tracking
down the killers.
（批：Liu 19/10）

《字林西报》，1939年10月19日
25932
法租界巡捕房
政治部华籍主管
晨间遇刺
乘坐私人黄包车时遭枪手射击头部和背部；前任
亦于5月6日以类似方式遭枪击
刺客沿空旷街道成功逃脱；车夫受伤
曾海刀（Zeng Hai-do），38岁，法租界公董局巡捕房政治部华籍代理总督察，昨天早晨在租界内惨遭暗杀。曾先生上午7时45分乘坐黄包车前往办公室途中，头部和背部中弹，受致命伤。当他沿孔蒂路（Rue Conty）行驶至接近海军上将拜尔路（Rue Amiral Bayle）时，遭到四名枪手射击。
曾先生接替了已故的法租界巡捕房政治部前华籍主管曹炳松（Tsao Ping-sung）先生的职务，曹先生也曾于5月6日上午在其赫维德斯耶斯路（Route Herves des Sieyes）的寓所内被身份不明的歹徒暗杀。
这位刺客子弹的最新受害者刚离开孔蒂路685弄40号的住所，正乘坐黄包车，行至森蒂路（Rue Centy）309号一家中国工厂门前时，突然有两人上前叫他的名字。听到有人叫曾先生的名字，黄包车夫放慢了速度，但在他或受害者弄清发生什么事之前，另外两人从后方逼近，拔出手枪向曾先生开了四枪。
一颗子弹嵌入曾先生的头部，另一颗击中其左肩，第三颗穿透其背部。第四颗子弹擦伤了受害者黄包车夫的颈部，造成皮肉伤。
枪手逃脱
由于清晨时分道路上几乎空无一人，且附近没有警察，刺客四散奔逃并成功脱身。警方随即接到报警，救护车被派往枪击现场。救护车到达时受害者已经死亡，因此未被送往医院，而是被送回家中。
除了吓得魂不附体的黄包车夫外，昨天未能找到其他目击者。车夫提供的关于刺客的信息极少。他看到了他们，但几乎无法描述他们的特征。
长期服务
曾先生在法租界公董局巡捕房服务已达12年。在接替曹先生担任政治部华籍代理总督察之前，他是同一部门的首席翻译。
死者去世时年仅38岁。他是安徽省徽州人。他的上司和同事昨天对他的英年早逝深感痛惜。曾先生遗下妻子和三个儿子（分别为12岁、15岁和18岁）、一个弟弟和一个妹妹，以及64岁的父亲，这些人当时都与他同住。
由于所有刺客在警察到达之前均已成功逃脱，侦探们昨天整天都在进行广泛的调查，以期追踪到凶手。
（批：Liu 10/19）

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.

OCT 18 1939

Political Branch
Suffers Second
Killing Of Year

Zeng Hai-Do Attacked
Riding In Ricsha
To Office

ZAO PING-SUNG
DEATH COPIED

Motives For Shooting
Proving Problem
To Trace

An assassination gun barked
again in Shanghai today, when
Secretary-Interpreter Zeng Hai-do
of the French Police Political De-
partment was killed in Rue Amiral
Bayle at 7.55 a.m.

Mr. Zeng's death duplicates that
of his predecessor in the Political
Department, Superintendent Zao
Ping-sung, who was also shot and
killed, some four months ago.

Going To Work

Leaving his home in Rue Amiral
Bayle to go to work this morning,
Mr. Zeng had only proceeded a
short distance in his ricsha when
he was killed ten yards from Rue
Conty.

A single Chinese gunman step-
ped from the sidewalk and at
short range fired three shots into
Mr. Zeng, hitting him in the back
and neck, killing him instantly.
The assassin then made his escape.

Twelve Years

Thirty-seven years of age, Mr.
Zeng had served 12 years with the
French Police. No reason for his
killing has been found as yet by
the detectives working on the case
and investigations are being made
to see whether it was a per-
sonal affair, the result of inquiries
made in the course of his duties
or terrorism.

Mr. Zeng leaves behind him
three sons, children of his first
marriage, and his 27 years old
widow whom he only married three
months ago. Mr. Zeng's father
is resident in Shanghai.

Lili
C 19/10

《上海晚邮报与信使报》

1939年10月18日

政治部
遭遇今年第二起
杀人案

曾海刀在乘
黄包车去办公室
途中遇袭

曹炳松
之死重演

射击动机
成为追查
难题

今天上海再次响起暗杀的枪声，法租界巡捕房政治部的秘书兼翻译曾海刀（Zeng Hai-do）于上午7时55分在海军上将拜尔路被杀。
曾先生的死重复了其政治部前任主管曹炳松（Superintendent Zao Ping-sung）的遭遇，后者也在大约四个月前被枪杀。
去上班
今天早上，曾先生离开海军上将拜尔路的住所去上班，乘坐黄包车仅走了一小段距离，就在距离孔蒂路十码的地方被杀。
一名中国枪手从人行道上走出，近距离向曾先生开了三枪，击中其背部和颈部，使其当场死亡。随后刺客逃逸。
十二年
曾先生现年三十七岁，已在法租界巡捕房服务12年。负责此案的侦探尚未找到其被杀的原因，调查正在进行中，以查明这是个人恩怨、因其职务调查所致，还是恐怖主义行为。
曾先生遗下前妻所生的三个儿子，以及他三个月前才娶的27岁的遗孀。曾先生的父亲居住在上海。
Lili
C 10/19

Section 1, Special Branch

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9631 C

REPORT
Date October 18, 1930

Subject Assassination of Cheng Hai Dao, Acting Chief of the Chinese Staff
of the Political Section of the French Police

Made by D.I. Fan Lien Pih Forwarded by C. Gaspari

Whilst proceeding to his office from his
home at 40 Heng Chong Li, Rue Amiral Bayle in a
public ricsha, Cheng Hai Dao (程洪濤), clerk and
Acting Chief of the Chinese Staff of the Political
Section of the French Police, was fatally shot from
behind at 7.50 a.m. October 18, 1939 at the inter-
section of Rue Amiral Bayle and Rue Conty by an
assassin who fired four shots in all two of which
found their mark. He was killed instantly.

It has been ascertained that in the early
part of August, 1939, Cheng Hai Dao joined the Wang
Ching Wei clique, which issued a monthly allowance
of $800.00 to Cheng through Ting Muh-tsung, (Com-
mander of the Special Service Corps of the Chung Kuo
Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National Salvation
Army, an armed gang of the Wang clique.)

It has been reported that prior to his
death and since joining the Wang Ching Wei clique,
Cheng sent additional copies of any reports of
importance to Ting Muh Tsung whenever these came into
his hands.

Pan Lien-pik
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务部门登记处
编号 S. B. D. 9631 C

报告
日期 1930年10月18日 [注：原文年份为1930，结合上下文应为1939之误，照实译出]

事由：法租界巡捕房政治部华籍职员代理主管程海刀遇刺案

撰写人：侦探督察范连璧（Fan Lien Pih） 转呈人：C. Gaspari

1939年10月18日上午7时50分，法租界巡捕房政治部华籍职员兼代理主管程海刀（Cheng Hai Dao，程洪濤）乘坐公共黄包车从海军上将拜尔路恒崇里40号的住所前往办公室途中，在海军上将拜尔路与孔蒂路交叉口，被一名刺客从背后开枪射击。刺客共开四枪，其中两枪命中。他当场死亡。

经查明，1939年8月上旬，程海刀加入了汪精卫派系，该派系通过丁慕宗（Ting Muh-tsung，“中国国民党反共救国军特别服务队”指挥官，汪派武装团伙）每月向程发放津贴800.00元。

据报道，在去世前，自加入汪精卫派系以来，程海刀每当手头有重要报告时，都会额外抄送副本给丁慕宗。

潘连璧
侦探督察

副总监（特务部门）

3 & Final

13-9-39 to 27-10-39 General Enquires

Since forwarding of last diary in this case
diligent enquires have been carried out by detectives
concerned and as a result the following facts have
been established:-

It would appear that prior to the outbreak of
Sino-Japanese Hostilities in August 1937, Nyi Hai Van
(新海帆) the victim in this crime, was a section
chief of the now defunct Social Bureau under Pan Kung
Chan( )(Wu Te Chen's regime), and with the liquida-
tion of this bureau, he like any other Kuomintang
members, devoted his services to refugee relief and
educational work, also he is reported to have been one
of the promoters of the Heng Nyi Lee( ) Society
a pro-Chunking Political Party.

Amongst the numerous positions held by Nyi Hai
Van was that of Principal of the Ta Hai Middle School
located at 1458 E/well Road, and as can be seen from
documents found on his person and at his office there
remains no doubt that he was constantly in touch with
his former chief, Pan Kung Chan who according to informa-
tion at hand, is at present a member of the Chunking
Kuomintang Headquarters.

In view of his alledged Pro-Chunking leanings

罪案科
1939年11月14日
I

3 & Final

1939年9月13日至10月27日 一般查询

自从本案上一份日志发出以来，相关侦探进行了勤勉的调查，结果确立了以下事实：

看来，在1937年8月中日敌对行动爆发之前，本案受害人倪海帆（Nyi Hai Van，新海帆）曾是潘公展（Pan Kung Chan，吴德臣政权时期）领导下现已解散的社会局的科长。随着该局的撤销，他像其他国民党成员一样，投身于难民救济和教育工作。另有报道称，他是恒毅社（Heng Nyi Lee Society，一个亲重庆的政治团体）的发起人之一。

在倪海帆担任的众多职务中，包括位于伊威尔路1458号的大海中学校长。从在他身上及其办公室发现的文件可以看出，毫无疑问，他与其前任上司潘公展保持经常联系。根据现有情报，潘公展目前是重庆国民党总部的成员。

鉴于其所谓的亲重庆倾向

（左侧手写批注：）
